source.method: Instantiate the original compiled C_ITEM constructors in DaedalusVm; read damage_total (damageTotal), damage_type (damagetype), flags and damage[8]. The original DAT hash matches the game base programs.json source. Weapon names were collected from EQUIPITEM calls while instantiating all NPC constructors in far-fight-pairs.json; unrelated external calls were ignored. Unarmed HITCHANCE[0] was read from the VLK_474_BUERGER constructor; Npc::hitChance returns this script field directly.
source.command:
uv run --no-project --with zenkit==1.3.0.4 python - "$GOTHIC_DAT" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, sys, zenkit
from zenkit.daedalus.npc import NpcInstanceTalent
from zenkit.daedalus.item import DamageType
path = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
vm = zenkit.DaedalusVm.load(str(path))
names = ('ITMW_1H_BAU_AXE', 'ITMW_1H_BAU_MACE', 'ITMW_1H_MIL_SWORD', 'ITMW_1H_SLD_AXE', 'ITMW_1H_SLD_SWORD', 'ITMW_2H_SLD_AXE', 'ITMW_2H_SLD_SWORD')
weapons = {}
for name in names:
    item = vm.init_instance(name, zenkit.DaedalusInstanceType.ITEM)
    weapons[name] = dict(damage_total=item.damage_total, damagetype=item.damage_type, flags=item.flags, damage=[item.get_damage(DamageType(i)) for i in range(8)])
vm.register_external_default(lambda symbol: None)
npc = vm.init_instance('VLK_474_BUERGER', zenkit.DaedalusInstanceType.NPC)
print(json.dumps(dict(sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), weapons=weapons, unarmed_hitchance={'VLK_474_BUERGER': npc.get_hit_chance(NpcInstanceTalent.UNKNOWN)}), indent=2))
PY
